dialog.english:
We've been here before, but this
place still gives me the creeps...
dialog.translation:
Ya hemos estado aquí, pero
este sitio me sigue dando
escalofríos...

dialog.english:
We barely made it out last time...
are we gonna be okay?
dialog.translation:
La última vez salimos por
los pelos... ¿vamos a estar
bien?

dialog.english:
It's fine... as soon as we find
it, we'll go back.
dialog.translation:
Tranquila... en cuanto lo
encontremos, volvemos.

dialog.english: Gyah!

Sorry, sorry! Didn't mean to scare
you, but...

Tai! Guys! Have you all been
secretly following us?

More importantly, why'd you come
back here, of all places?
dialog.translation:
Eso da igual, ¿por qué
volvisteis aquí precisamente?

dialog.english:
Sora came back to find something
she lost.
dialog.translation:
Sora volvió a buscar algo
que perdió.

dialog.english: What'd you lose?
Well, it's... not a big deal.

They locked Sora and Piyomon up
here...
dialog.translation:
Aquí encerraron a Sora y
Piyomon...

dialog.english:
Hey, Sora, did you find what you
were looking for?
It's not in the cell...

You must've dropped it when you
went through the hole.
dialog.translation:
Se te caería al pasar por
el agujero.

dialog.english: Yeah... let's check there.
Nope... it didn't fall here...

I mean, what'd you drop? I can
help you if you tell me.
dialog.translation:
O sea, ¿qué se te cayó? Puedo
ayudarte si me lo dices.

dialog.english:
It's fine! Don't worry about it.
I'll find it if I keep looking.
dialog.translation:
¡Está bien! No te preocupes.
Lo encontraré si sigo
buscando.

dialog.english:
You're not hiding something from
us, are you? Like food?
No! I'm not like you, Tai...

Oowoo... this is a nice bracelet!
It fits my white body so well...
dialog.translation:
Oowoo... ¡qué pulsera tan
bonita! Le queda genial
a mi cuerpo...

dialog.english:
Did someone just pick it up? This
is bad! We've got to hurry and get
it back!
dialog.translation:
¿Alguien la ha cogido? ¡Esto
es malo! ¡Hay que
recuperarla ya!

dialog.english: Wait, Sora!

Tres bien! I'll be so popular with
this bracelet!
dialog.translation:
¡Tres bien! ¡Seré muy popular
con esta pulsera!

dialog.english: A B-Bakemon?!

W-Wait! That's what I lost! Give
it back!

Who are you? This is something *I*
picked up!

Give it back! That's important to
me!

Then you and I can have a battle
for it! En garde!

I have no idea what you're saying,
but I'll take it back!
dialog.translation:
¡No tengo ni idea de qué
dices, pero la recuperaré!

dialog.english:
The loser is moi. A complete
defeat.
dialog.translation:
La perdedora soy moi.
Derrota total.

dialog.english:
Thank goodness... my lucky
bracelet!
dialog.translation:
¡Menos mal... mi pulsera de
la suerte!

dialog.english:
A lucky bracelet? Don't you wear
that when there's a wish you want
to come true?
dialog.translation:
¿Una pulsera de la suerte?
¿No te la pones cuando quieres
que se cumpla un deseo?

dialog.english:
It must be a really important
wish.
dialog.translation:
Debe de ser un deseo muy
importante.

dialog.english:
Yeah... the truth is, my mom
doesn't approve of me playing
soccer.
dialog.translation:
Sí... la verdad es que mi
madre no aprueba que juegue
al fútbol.

dialog.english:
She's a flower arrangement school
head, and she'd rather I arrange
flowers than play soccer...
dialog.translation:
Ella dirige una escuela de
arreglos florales, y prefiere
eso al fútbol...

dialog.english:
Whoa! Do you wear kimono and all
that, Sora?

Don't interrupt her, she's
talking!

So... my mom gave me this a while
ago. She made it with sewing
thread.
dialog.translation:
Bueno... mi madre me dio
esto hace tiempo. La hizo
con hilo de coser.

dialog.english:
And she used beautiful embroidery
thread, so I thought...
dialog.translation:
Y usó un hilo de bordar
precioso, así que pensé...

dialog.english:
You think if your bracelet breaks,
your mom will let you play soccer?
dialog.translation:
¿Crees que si se rompe la
pulsera, tu madre te dejará
jugar al fútbol?

dialog.english:
It's not a big deal, but it's
important to me...
dialog.translation:
No es nada importante,
pero significa mucho...

dialog.english:
I'm sure your wish will come true,
Sora!
dialog.translation:
¡Seguro que tu deseo se
cumple, Sora!

dialog.english: Yeah!

Huh! And I thought you were hiding
food from us!
dialog.translation:
¡Vaya! ¡Y yo que pensaba que
nos escondías comida!

dialog.english: ...Tai!

It was a joke! Don't get mad at
me...
Hahaha!

It must have fallen somewhere in
this basement...
dialog.translation:
Debió de caerse en algún
lugar de este sótano...

dialog.english:
What are you looking for, Sora?
If you tell me, I'll help look!
dialog.translation:
¿Qué buscas, Sora? ¡Si me lo
dices, te ayudo a buscar!

dialog.english: It's fine! I'll take care of it!
Thank you... but leave it to me.

Sora, what's wrong? You're acting
weird!
I'm sorry, Mimi...

Oh! I was just a little
surprised...
Okay...

Sorry, Mimi. I'm sure Sora has a
reason for this.
dialog.translation:
Perdona, Mimi. Seguro que
Sora tiene un motivo.

dialog.english: I'll just watch for now, then.
